ruleDefinitions.name: Meterpreter or Cobalt Strike Getsystem Service Installation - System
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the use of getsystem Meterpreter/Cobalt Strike command by detecting a specific service installation Note: Unmapped fields: Provider_Name, ImagePath

sequences.query: (Provider_Name = "Service\ Control\ Manager" AND event_id = 7045) AND (((ImagePath = RGX(".*\\/c.*") AND ImagePath = RGX(".*echo.*") AND ImagePath = RGX(".*\\\\pipe\\\\.*")) AND (ImagePath = RGX(".*cmd.*") OR ImagePath = RGX(".*\\%COMSPEC\\%.*"))) OR (ImagePath = RGX(".*rundll32.*") AND ImagePath = RGX(".*\\\.dll\\,a.*") AND ImagePath = RGX(".*\\/p\\:.*")) OR ImagePath = RGX("^\\\\\\\\127\\\.0\\\.0\\\.1\\\\ADMIN\\$\\\\"))
